summary: A local committee turns a neighbor's willingness to serve into a recorded precinct appointment.
realLife: The February minutes record a motion, a second and unanimous approval of Jill Gilliom as a precinct committee officer in Milton.

turns.what: The chair puts the appointment to a vote.
turns.writesBack: The minutes link the new officer to the place served.

turns.writesBack: The record is completed before a vote.
